responsibility: Defines the canonical rs6000 CPU-name table and the feature-mask formulas used to derive target defaults from -mcpu= and related settings. It enumerates supported processor names, maps each to a processor_type and baseline option-mask set, and also defines grouped ISA mask macros and vector-feature dependency masks that other generated tables and option-override code use to build CPU option enums, default ISA selections, and feature enable/disable logic.
